subject.title: ci: gate secret scanning remediation approval

question: Should this workflow be allowed to read body-bearing issue/PR/comment resources before protected-environment approval, and is `secret-remediation` configured with required reviewers before write rollout?
rationale: The source diff cannot prove the repository-level protected environment or choose the intended secret-handling boundary; a maintainer with repo administration context must confirm it.

options.title: Fix and prove the gate before merge
options.body: Move body/comment reads behind approval or make plan metadata-only, then verify the protected environment with required reviewers before enabling the write job.

options.title: Pause until repository rollout exists
options.body: Keep the PR open under human review until admins create and verify `secret-remediation` outside the source tree.

options.title: Accept broader plan access explicitly
options.body: Maintainers may choose to allow read-only plan access to body-bearing resources, but that weaker boundary should be documented and tested as an intentional tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove the gate before merge
recommendation.body: Move body/comment reads behind approval or make plan metadata-only, then verify the protected environment with required reviewers before enabling the write job.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body names `steipete` for the first environment rollout reviewer, and the remaining decision depends on protected-environment administration.
